evidence_quote: I tested this on `falkordb/falkordb:v4.14.8` and reproduced the string `"[2, 1]"` from `GRAPH.QUERY` without `--compact`. A plain list (`RETURN [2,1]`) is displayed the same way. FalkorDB’s [result format documentation](https://docs.falkordb.com/design/result-structure#arrays) says the default response represents lists as strings.
